comment: slot label: a `slotfather run` the agent types must carry a --label that names the task and what it does, since everyone reads labels on the slotfather dashboard to decide whether to wait or reprioritize. Deny cases name why the label is refused (`says`) and the example label built from the command (`example`); allow cases include the wrappers that lease on their own (Lanefather, repo-kit, project verify scripts) and a pasted Lanefather lease. Commands run in {home}/app unless `cwd` says otherwise.

deny.name: no label
deny.command: slotfather run -n 1 -- python3 -m unittest discover -s tests

deny.name: no label, ticket given
deny.command: slotfather run -n 2 --priority batch --ticket gf-1b -- cargo test

deny.name: label equal to the directory name
deny.command: slotfather run -n 1 --label app -- bun run build

deny.name: inside a chain, by full path
deny.command: set -o pipefail; ~/.local/bin/slotfather run -n 1 --priority batch -- uv run pytest -q | tail -5

deny.name: lane meta without a label
deny.command: slotfather run -n 1 --meta lane=597-x --meta phase=check -- python3 tools/check.py

deny.name: example pasted with its placeholder
deny.command: slotfather run -n 1 --label "<ticket> build" -- bun run build

allow.name: task and what it does
allow.command: slotfather run -n 1 --priority batch --label "gf-1b cpu-measure" -- python3 tools/measure.py

allow.name: one hyphenated word that says both
Lanefather lease, pasted
allow.command: /usr/local/bin/slotfather run -n 1 --label lane-480-x --meta lane=480-x --meta lanefather.state=checking --priority normal -- ./verify.sh --checks lint

allow.name: mentioned, not run
allow.command: grep -n 'slotfather run' docs/agents/checks.md && echo slotfather run -n 1
